The '''Commander''' is the term for players in ''Transformers: Forged to Fight''. On the game's top taskbar, you can view at a glance your strongest Bot, Alliance name, level and experience, and unused Mastery points. Your avatar is the strongest Bot you have. All Commanders have a Commander Profile, from which anyone can view a Commander's in-game name, his/her three [[Bots|Top Bots]], and other stats. On the left side of a profile, you can view: (those marked 'private' can only be viewed by yourself) * The Commader's name and XP Level. * [[Masteries]] (private) * [[Medal]] count * [[Alliance]] name, total rating, and position In the overview tab you can view: * [[Raid Shield|Shield]] activity (private) * Total Bots * Total Rating * Defense Rating * Top 3 Bots and their rank and level * [[Module|Top 3 Mods]] and their rank and level (private) In the Boosts tab, you can view your active [[Boosts]], including those received from Alliance help In the '''Stats '''tab, you can view a Commander's Mission stats: * Total Missions Completed * Daily Missions Completed * Mission Fights Won * [[Arena]] Fights Won * Highest [[Arena]] Win Streak * [[Raid|Raid Attacks]] Won * [[Raid|Raid Defends]] Won == Level Up Rewards == When a Commander earns enough XP to advance to the next level, he/she will be rewarded items, as well as unlock new features.
